items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, that's right. Fletcher Henderson, and Duke, and a lot of the big bands.

ctx.x: Who influenced you in arranging, if anybody? There are so many things -- like I was talking last week about the sax solely on one of the tunes that you arranged. It sounds very much like Fletcher Henderson. Did you listen to other arrangers, and say, gee, I'd like to do something like that? Say a Fletcher Henderson arrangement?
Yeah, that's right. Fletcher Henderson, and Duke, and a lot of the big bands.
